experiment_data.hypothesis: exp-003 的 horseshoe prior 导致 MCMC 不收敛（R-hat=1.73, ESS=6）。替换为 HalfNormal hierarchical prior（sigma_c ~ HalfNormal(1), c_raw ~ HalfNormal(1)^N, c = c_raw * sigma_c），该配置在 mvp_003 合成数据上收敛良好（R-hat=1.03, ESS=224）。预期真实数据上 joint_gmfrm 也能收敛（R-hat<1.05, ESS>100），同时保持 τ 优势（exp-003 dry-run τ=0.857 vs sequential τ=0.786）。

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda,cpu XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.25 python run_exp003.py --judgment-dir /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001/results --exposure-csv /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp002/results/exposure_scores.csv --output-dir /root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp003/output_003b --warmup 4000 --samples 4000 --chains 4 --target-accept 0.95 --device gpu --methods joint_gmfrm
spec.model_name: G-MFRM (HalfNormal hierarchical prior, NCP, 4-chain sequential MCMC)
spec.checkpoint_source: exp-003 (horseshoe to HalfNormal hierarchical prior fix)
spec.eval_data: exp-001 real Arena-Hard judgments (8 models x 9 judges x 176 items) + exp-002 exposure scores
